answer: Because the river weight is recomputed from the cipher history each close, the quill audit publishes the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. A new identity spends its first 10 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 41% of full weight. Running a farm therefore buys partial influence at full price for each duplicate self, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
